Hello!

I am doing multispecies occupancy modeling using Rota et al. (2016). I was doing model selection with the "modSel" function and compared the results with the aictab function from AICmodavg package and got different results. Any suggestions please?

Thank you!
Carla

messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] model selection multispecies occupancy
parts:
Hi,

aictab( ) computes AICc as the default information criterion. aictab(,
second.ord = TRUE) gives you an AIC table, with identical AIC values as
those obtained with modSel( ).

Best,

Marc
